profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Hi! My name is Parth. I graduated in May, 2021 with a Bachelor's in Science with a major in Computer Science and minor in Statistics. Feel free to connect and DM me if you have any questions!

positions.title: Software Engineer (Intermediate) - Grade 601
positions.locationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Part of Commercial and Investment Banking department (CIB - Post Trade Technology)
• Responsible for managing high-net-worth individual and corporate portfolios (assets exceeding $25 million), including stocks, bonds, and other investment options.
• Oversee the settlement, mapping, and book keeping of cash flows across multiple JP Morgan legal entities globally, ensuring accurate daily reporting based on deposits and location-specific data.
• Working with a diverse tech stack, including Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, AMPS, and RabbitMQ, alongside various sophisticated internal tools to streamline operations and enhance efficiency.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Associate)
positions.description:
• Collaborating within an Agile environment and following micro-services architecture to develop multiple enterprise-level web services.
• Contributing to architectural design discussions, coding solutions that precisely meet business requirements, all while adhering to project timelines and budgets.
• Designing and implementing multiple RESTful APIs using Java/J with Spring Boot framework while ensuring optimal performance and scalability that serves at least 4-7 million requests each day.
• Extensively working with RabbitMQ and Kafka for seamless transmission and reception of messages, enhancing system communication efficiency.
• Implementing and managing CI/CD pipelines to automate the build, test, and deployment processes for projects.
• Designed and configured pipeline stages for tasks such as unit testing, integration testing, Sonar scan etc using Gitlab CI and handling CD on AWS using Harness.
• Writing comprehensive Unit and Integration test cases using JUnit, Mockito, WireMock and TestContainers (Selenium/PlayWright for UI testing) to ensure robust code quality. Led the migration of more than 700 contract automation tests from Python to Java utilizing Rest Assured Library, Hibernate and Custom SQL queries.
• Reviewing and reproducing product defects and bugs reported by customers/clients and dead letter queues, maintaining high standards of issue resolution and documenting major identified defects on Confluence, while providing clear and comprehensive information to expedite the resolution process.
• Identifying system requirements and partner dependencies to workload balancing, software implementation, engineering, testing, and configuring metrics, alarms, monitors, and dashboards on DynaTrace and Graylog.
• Creating documentation for both existing and newly developed microservices using diagrams, Swagger, JavaDocs and Postman collection
